//regions: bom1 is Mumbai. Requests already ARRIVE at the Mumbai edge, but the
functions were executing in iad1 (Washington DC) - the Vercel default -
while the database sits in ap-south-1, which is also Mumbai. So every
query a page made travelled India -> US -> India and back, measured at
roughly 300ms of avoidable latency on every dynamic request, compounding
on pages that run several queries in sequence.
Set here rather than with Next's preferredRegion export, which is
deprecated in this version of Next and now only accepts auto/global/home
on Vercel - none of which can name Mumbai.
One region, not a list: a list deploys to ALL of them, and a second
region would only move functions further from the one database.
If a deploy is rejected for this, it is a plan restriction rather than a
mistake in the file - region selection is limited on the Hobby plan.
